input.quote: Garman is the owner of all intellectual property rights in the Work (including any Improvements or Modifications thereto), including all related materials, logos, and names provided pursuant to the terms of this Agreement. No title to the intellectual property in the Work is transferred to Sparkling by this Agreement.
input.rationale: Garman's ownership of its platform is fine, but Section 13 also gives Garman ownership of the Modifications built to our Schedule "D" specifications while our only licence is a restricted, location-limited use right (broader source-code rights arise only on Garman default under Section 16(b)), and the Agreement never states that Sparkling retains its own data. That falls short of the fallback licence-back. We proposed a single added sentence confirming our data ownership and a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence to use and modify Sparkling-specific Modifications and Improvements.

input.quote: Garman hereby grants to Sparkling, for the use of Sparkling and affiliated companies of Sparkling operating at Authorized Locations, a non-transferable and non-exclusive licence to use
input.rationale: Affiliates are covered and the licence is not revocable at will, but it is expressly non-transferable (so it would not follow the business in an M&A transaction, failing the fallback) and contractors acting on our behalf are excluded with no path to add them. We proposed adding contractors and successor transferability in the grant; the related agreement-level assignment bar is addressed separately under ASSIGN.
